facts: The 14-metre dome and 62.5-centimetre instrument remain in the purpose-built Penteli building.

owner: National Observatory of Athens, Institute of Astronomy
facts: The building was finished in 1958 in Pentelic marble.

owner: Hellenic Archives of Scientific Instruments, AST73
facts: Kassandras authored the architectural plan. The chamber stands over a concrete pier and a vertically movable floor. The observed instrument focal length is 8.86 m.

owner: Scientific survey of astronomy in Greece
facts: The roof is aluminium-clad with a roughly four-metre shutter. Historical sources disagree on dome diameter. The building owner and instrument archive agree on 14 m, which the model uses.
